items.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We Steer Clear Of
items.summary: Consumer discretionary businesses are levered to the highs and lows of economic cycles. Over the past six months, it seems like demand may be facing some headwinds as the industry’s 2.3% return has lagged the S&P 500 by 11.3 percentage points.

items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks That Fall Short
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: Wynn Resorts (WYNN) Stock Looks Fairly Priced Despite Al Marjan Delays
